prompt:
Judge one fact extracted for a SysML v2 model from an engineering document. The fact names elements by their full names; the document may refer to them by aliases declared elsewhere (those declarations are included).

Fact: action(label=may be inserted later when approved operational justification is recorded)

Source sentences (the last one is where the fact was extracted):
S032: The Mission Control Center maintains the operational contact schedule and uses it as the controlling reference for console staffing, command readiness, and telemetry coverage.
S033: The Network Control System distributes station allocations, confirms antenna readiness states, and records the actual start and end times of each contact.
S034: Contact booking requests are submitted through the Mission Planning System with the required service type, antenna preference, minimum elevation, data volume expectation, and priority class.
S035: Routine contacts are frozen at the daily planning cut-off, while contingency contacts may be inserted later when approved operational justification is recorded.

"supported": every slot value is stated or directly implied by the sentences. "partially_supported": the main relation is right but a slot is wrong, over-specific or unsupported. "unsupported": the fact is not stated, contradicts the text, or assigns the wrong element. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"partially_supported","reason":"The text says contingency contacts may be inserted later when approved operational justification is recorded, but the fact's label drops the subject (contingency contacts) and presents the clause as an action, so it is only a fragment of the stated relation."}
